description: Experimental, not for merge. Spring Boot (Tomcat, JDK 25, virtual threads) scaled out to 3 replicas behind one nginx edge that terminates TLS + h2, serves /static/* from disk and round-robins the dynamic endpoints over loopback HTTP/1.1. The replicas share 24 logical CPUs through 8-CPU quotas, 16g each and a 64-connection Hikari pool each; compare with spring-boot-gateway-8, which spends the same totals on 8 replicas.
